Synopsis:
A bandit in an abandoned chapel - she's trying and failing to open a door to the lower level of the chapel, searching for loot. Talking to herself as she struggles - confused by the fact the door doesn't have a lock.

context: You're overhearing a lone bandit trapped on the far side of a heavy interior door in an abandoned chapel, trying to get into the lower crypt to loot it. She locked or barricaded the door from inside and is speaking through it to anyone outside — the players are on the outside and can't see her; her companions nearby have likely been driven off or killed already. She's muttering to herself out of frustration (mentioning a drink, wondering where a lock or handle is) because the doorway appears to have no obvious lock or latch. The odd, almost irreverent nature of the doorway echoes other strange doors in the area (skull motifs and crypt entrances), which helps explain why she’s puzzled and inept at dealing with it.
